method: Tree crowns found in the LiDAR canopy model; biomass per tree from height and crown width (Jucker et al. 2017, Global Change Biology 23:177-190); roots +22% (Mokany et al. 2006); carbon 47% of dry biomass (IPCC 2006); CO2-e = carbon x 44/12. Indicative, about +/-35%.
caveat2008: The 2008 survey had about 3 points per m2 (2022: about 53), so 2008 heights and crowns read low; changes from 2008 overstate growth. 2014 (about 14 per m2) to 2022 is the fairer comparison.
